xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DisclosureOfNotesOnFinancialRe:
1. Notes related to results specifically profit and loss
Amounts reported in Other Expenses as Expenses capitalised is seperate line item in published results, however as there is no separate placeholder in XBRL hence it is been shown under Other Expenses.

2.The Company mainly operates in the business of manufacturing of Engines wherein two customer based reportable segments had been identified namely - Business to Business ("B2B") and Business to Customer ("B2C") (upto 10th October 2025 - Refer note 5) . However, post transfer of net assets of B2C business segment, the Company operates in a segment of B2B only at standalone level. Further as per para 4 of Ind AS 108 “Operating Segments”, the Company is required to disclose segment information only in the consolidated financial results. Accordingly, disclosure of this information has been included under consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026.

3.The above statement has been prepared in accordance with The Companies (Indian Accounting Standards) Rules, 2015 (Ind AS) prescribed under section 133 of The Companies Act, 2013 and other recognised accounting practices and policies to the extent applicable.

4.The standalone financial results for the year ended 31st March 2026 included the impact of exceptional items amounting Rs. 29.68 Crores pertaining to incremental impact on account of the New Labour Codes.

5.The Board of Directors of the Company in its meeting held on 10th October 2025 approved the transfer of the Company's Business to Customer (“B2C”) business segment i.e. Water Management Solutions (“WMS”) – Domestic & Exports Business by way of slump sale as a going concern to its wholly owned subsidiary, 'KOEL Fluid Dynamics Private Limited' ("KFD") (formerly known as La-Gajjar Machineries Private Limited ("LGM")).

The aforesaid B2C business segment of the Company was transferred to KFD with effect from 11th October 2025. The consideration was in the form of issuance and allotment of 10,65,150 equity shares of KFD having face value of Rs. 10/- each to the Company, on a private placement basis, on terms as set out in the Business Transfer Agreement. Accordingly, the net assets of Rs. 18.88 Crores was transferred on a slump sale basis at their carrying values, and the consideration was accounted for at such carrying values of net assets as an addition to the Company’s investment in the subsidiary, consistent with the Company’s accounting policy, in accordance with the applicable Indian accounting standards.

The operations of the Business to Customer (“B2C”) business of the Company is classified as discontinued operations for all the periods presented in these standalone financial results of the Company, in accordance with the applicable accounting standards. Since the transaction was with the wholly owned subsidiary company, there is no impact on the consolidated financial results.

6. The results of the business classified as discontinued operations in the standalone financial results are as under:
(a) Revenue from operations and other income : Nil ( Previous Quarter: Rs. 145.31 Crores; YTD FY26 Rs.318.07 )
(b) Total expenses : Current quarter: Nil ( Previous Quarter: Rs. 135.55 Crores; YTD FY26 Rs. 290.58)
(c) Profit/(loss) before tax (a-b) : Current quarter: Nil ( Previous Quarter: Rs. 9.76 Crores; TYD FY26Rs. 27.49)
(d) Tax expense/(income) of discontinued operations : Current quarter: Nil ( Previous Quarter Rs. 2.46 Crores; YTD FY26: Rs. 6.92)
Profit/(loss) after tax (c - d) : Current quarter: Nil ( Previous Quarter: Rs. 7.30 Crores; YTD FY26: Rs.20.57)

7.During the quarter ended 30th September 2026, the Company has allotted 1,86,280 fully paid-up equity shares of Rs. 2/- each to the option grantees upon exercise of Employee Stock Options pursuant to ‘Kirloskar Oil Engines Limited – Employee Stock Option Plan 2019' ('KOEL ESOP 2019'). Consequent to aforesaid allotment, the paid-up equity share capital of the Company has increased from 14,53,79,944 fully paid-up equity shares of Rs. 2/- each to 14,55,66,224 fully paid-up equity shares of Rs. 2/- each.

8.The figures for the previous periods have been regrouped wherever required to make them comparable with those of the current periods.

9.The above standalone financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026 are reviewed and recommended by the Audit Committee and approved by the Board of Directors of the Company in their respective meetings held on 4th November 2026 and are subjected to a "Limited Review" by the Statutory Auditors of the Company.


Additional Notes related to Cashflow:

i. The above cash flow statement has been prepared under the indirect method set out in Indian Accounting Standard (IND AS) 7, ‘Statement of Cash Flows’ as specified in the Companies (Indian Accounting Standards) Rules, 2015
ii.Income tax paid is treated as arising from operating activities and are not bifurcated between investing and financing activities.
iii.The above cash flow statement includes cash flow from discontinued operations (Refer note 5 above )

1. Amount shown under "Other adjustments for which cash effects are investing or financing cash flow " include:
a.Gain/(Loss) on sale of investments in mutual funds (net)
b. Gain on disposal of property, plant and equipment (net)

2. Amount included under "Other adjustments for non cash items" under operating activity include:
a.Bad debts and irrecoverable balances written off
b.Write down / (reversal) in write down of inventories and others (net)
c.Provisions no longer required written back
d.Unwinding of security deposit & subsidy receivable under Package Scheme of Incentives (PSI) Scheme, 2001
e.Sundry credit balances written back

3. Amount included under "Other inflows (outflows) of cash under investing activity include
- Redemption from / (Investment in) fixed deposits with banks


4.Amount included under," Repayment of Borrowings" include
a.(Repayment) of bill discounting and short term borrowings
b.(Repayment) of long term borrowings

xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DisclosureOfNotesOnSegmentsExp:
The Company mainly operates in the business of manufacturing of Engines wherein two customer based reportable segments had been identified namely - Business to Business ("B2B") and Business to Customer ("B2C") (upto 10th October 2025). However, post transfer of net assets of B2C business segment, the Company operates in a segment of B2B only at standalone level. Further as per para 4 of Ind AS 108 “Operating Segments”, the Company is required to disclose segment information only in the consolidated financial results. Accordingly, disclosure of this information has been included under consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026.

Explanatory notes related to XBRL :

In the General Info section, for the field Segment Reporting we have selected "Single Segment" though we have Multi Segments i.e B2B and B2C till 10th October 2025. However, post transfer of net assets of B2C business segment, the Company operates in a segment of B2B only at standalone level. When we are selecting Multi Segment in General Info Section, it is mandatory to fill in the Segment Reporting tab or else there is validation error. However as per para 4 of Ind AS 108 “Operating Segments”, the Company is required to disclose segment information only in the Consolidated Financial Results. Accordingly, disclosure of this information has been included under Consolidated Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended 30 September 2026. To keep the XBRL aligned with published standalone results and avoid the validation error, we have reported the Single segment in Info Section and reported the Consolidated segment in Consolidated XBRL Results file.

xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:RelatedPartyTransactionExplana: 1.The figures do not include provision for leave encashment and gratuity, as actuarial valuation for recording such provision is obtained at the company level and the same is not identificable at individual key managerial personnel. Sitting fees, remuneration and commission only paid to Directors forming part of promoter and promoter group are considered pursuant to regulation 23(9) of Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, including amendmends thereafter (SEBI LODR). 2.Cost associated with Employee Stock Option Plan (ESOP) has been recorded in financials as per the relevant Ind AS, however the perquisite value for ESOP which have not yet been vested and exercised are not included in the remuneration reported above, wherever applicable, as the same will be included at the time of exercise of options. 3.Terms and conditions of transactions with related parties : Transactions entered into with related party are made in ordinary course of business and on terms equivalent to those that prevail in arm’s length transactions. This assessment is undertaken each financial year through examining the financial position of the related party and the market in which the related party operates. 4.Other Commitment - The Ultimate Holding Company has given letter of comfort/undertaking to one of the step down subsidiary's bankers for credit facilities availed by that step-down subsidiary. As per the terms of letter of comfort/undertaking, the Ultimate Holding Company undertakes not to divest its ownership interest directly or indirectly in the step-down subsidiary beyond specified percentage. 5.No specific financial indebtedness is incurred to make or give investments except as disclosed above. 6.The value of transactions, opening and closing balances are after considering effect of prepaid and provision. Additionally, the closing balance in "Investment in equity shares/preference share/fund" represents the carrying value of investment as at the period end. 7.For foreign subsidiaries including step-down subidiaries, the transations and outstanding balances are inclusive of the effects of foreign exchange fluctuations. Movement in balances arising prinarily on account of foreign exchange fluctuation has not been reported in transactions but only as a part of the closing balance. 8.Transactions between members of the Group (between Kirloskar Oil Engines Limited and its subsidiaries/step-down subsidiaries or between subsidiaries/step-down subsidiaries) are reported once and excluding GST, wherever applicable. 9.Negative Amounts in the opening balance and closing balance columns represent credit balances. Transaction value having negative amounts represent credit transactions indicating income or inflows; whereas positive amounts represent debit transactions indicating expenses or outflows. 10.0.00'/-0.00 denotes amounts less than Rs.50,000 in absolute terms. 11.Pursuant to Regulation 23(9) of SEBI LODR, the remuneration and sitting fees paid to Directors or key managerial personnel or senior management except who is part of promoter or promoter group of Kirloskar Oil Engines Limited and its subsidiaries are not required to be disclosed and hence excluded in reporting above except for Arka Fincap Limited (Subsidiairy). 12.There are no transactions related to loans, inter-corporate deposits and advances and hence additional disclosures related to same are not applicable. 13.Sitting fees paid to directors for attending the meeting of board and committee as approved by Board of Directors of the Subsidiary Company. 14.As approved by the Nomination & remuneration Committee/Board of Directors of Arka Fincap Limited 15.The remuneration is paid by Arka Fincap Limited as its employees and it is being considered based on Form 130 (as per The Income Tax Act, 2025) which will be issued for FY 2026-27. 16.Provision for commision to directors has been recorded in financials on an estimated basis and is subject to approval from the board of directors, accordingly it has not been included in rendering of services. 17.Considering that the charges recovered by Kirloskar Management Services Private Limited is based on fix percentage on Net Interest Income of the Company, maximum value of transactions cannot be determined. 18.Audit Committee is not applicable. The transactions are on arm's length basis accordingly, the board of directors had noted the same.
